book.title: Computer Systems: A Programmer's Perspective
book.author: Randal E. Bryant and David R. O’Hallaron

predict.question: You send data with a budget of 60 time units. Each transfer spends 8 on payload work plus 2 on setup, and only whole transfers count. How much payload work gets through?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Computer performance requires accounting for overhead as well as useful operations.
modelBoundary: Both sizes complete {A} and {B} work. Larger transfers spend less setup per unit but leave unusable remainder under this whole-transfer rule.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This is fixed-cost packing, not cache simulation. Partial transfers and overlapping setup are excluded.
